title: Dem senator defeats challenger named 'No-Trump' in Delaware primary
summary: Chris Coons cruised past a challenger who legally changed his name to E. No-Trump Hansen, a candidate focused on curbing presidential power.

title: Trump admin imposes new visa restrictions over alleged racial discrimination, land seizures in South Africa
summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced visa restrictions targeting those responsible for land seizures and racial discrimination against Afrikaners in South Africa.

title: High-profile Democrat breaks with party, embraces key pieces of Trump agenda
summary: Haley Stevens backs Trump administration policies on critical minerals, data centers and public equity stakes in high-growth industries like Intel.

title: 64 House Democrats help Republicans kill Trump impeachment effort
summary: Al Green forced a Trump impeachment vote that fractured House Democrats, with Hakeem Jeffries and top leaders voting "present" to avoid taking a stand.

title: Trump-backed crypto bill fails to launch as Dems, Republicans unite to block it
summary: Sen. Cynthia Lummis declared the Clarity Act dead after Democrats and some Republicans blocked the massive crypto regulation bill in a key Senate vote.

title: ‘Still waiting on the DOGE check’: Battleground state voters cast doubt on Trump’s new $5K promise
summary: Detroit, Michigan, residents call gas prices, car insurance and rent "ridiculous" while dismissing Trump's $5,000 dividend as political "bribery."

title: Trump blasts Supreme Court 'disaster' after justices rule against him on mail-in voting
summary: Trump called Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas "legends" for dissenting and listed Supreme Court rulings that have gone against him.

title: Real Madrid faces controversy after three star players refuse to wear pro-Ceuta solidarity shirts before match
summary: Kylian Mbappé, Vinícius Júnior and Ibrahima Konaté refused to wear pro-Ceuta solidarity shirts before Real Madrid's match against Elche on Tuesday.

title: Ms Rachel says backlash over her Gaza posts 'doesn't faze' her as she calls out celebrity silence
summary: Children's YouTuber Ms. Rachel told Rolling Stone that backlash over her Gaza posts no longer fazes her after being accused of pushing anti-Israel messaging.

title: Airport X-ray shows terrifying object taped in carry-on to skip checked baggage fee
summary: A traveler at Dane County Regional Airport in Wisconsin taped a knife inside her carry-on bag to avoid paying a $100 baggage fee ahead of a camping trip, the TSA reported.
